svg.title: Six film frames of a bowler: run-up, gather, back foot, front foot, release, then the ball in flight. A highlighted band over the back-foot and front-foot frames, on the bowler's hand and arm, marks where the best batsmen are already reading; a later band over the ball in flight marks where everyone reads
svg.text: SEEING THE BALL BEFORE IT'S BOWLED

g.text: where the best batsmen are already reading
